_comment: Shown in the update prompts. Edit before each release. minVersion: apps older than this must update before they continue (use for security fixes); leave it at an old version normally.
notes: Club Town Hall: every member gets their own panel for their position
Club admins and the app admin can add and edit past committees
Messages now pop up as phone notifications
Event tickets you can tilt like a real 3D card
Easier reading on phones, and a bottom bar that stays put
Study Library: shared notes get a Verified badge from the team
